name: Downtown Dubai
blurb: Home to Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall — the city's most iconic address.

name: Dubai Marina
blurb: Waterfront towers, yacht life, and one of Dubai's liveliest promenades.

name: Palm Jumeirah
blurb: The world-famous man-made island of beachfront villas and resorts.

name: Business Bay
blurb: Dubai's dynamic business hub on the canal, minutes from Downtown.

name: Dubai Hills Estate
blurb: Master-planned green community around an 18-hole championship golf course.

name: Jumeirah Village Circle
blurb: Family-friendly, high-yield community at the centre of New Dubai.

name: Dubai Creek Harbour
blurb: Waterfront masterplan facing the Ras Al Khor wildlife sanctuary.

name: Sheikh Zayed Road
blurb: Dubai's iconic business spine, lined with landmark towers and swift metro access to every district.

name: Palm Jebel Ali
blurb: Nakheel's 16-frond coastal masterplan offering private beachfront villas twice the scale of Palm Jumeirah.

name: DAMAC Lagoons
blurb: Mediterranean-inspired family villa and townhouse clusters encircling crystal swimmable lagoons.

name: Emaar Beachfront
blurb: Gated private island inside Dubai Harbour with 1.5 km of white sandy beach and yacht berths.

name: DIFC
blurb: The Middle East's premier financial hub combining Grade-A offices, art galleries, and luxury towers.

name: MBR City
blurb: Lagoon-framed villa enclaves and modern apartment boulevards minutes from Downtown Dubai.

name: Tilal Al Ghaf
blurb: Resort-style family sanctuary centred on Lagoon Al Ghaf, shaded parks, and flagship international schooling.

name: Arabian Ranches
blurb: Dubai's quintessential green desert-golf villa neighbourhood prized by long-term families.

name: Dubai South
blurb: Aviation, Expo City, and crystal-lagoon growth corridor anchored by Al Maktoum International Airport.

name: Al Furjan
blurb: Metro-connected family villas, townhouses, and mid-rise residences bordering Discovery Gardens and Jebel Ali.

name: Jumeirah Lake Towers
blurb: Vibrant lakefront live-work clusters opposite Dubai Marina with two Red Line Metro stations and DMCC offices.

name: Bluewaters Island
blurb: Pedestrian coastal island off JBR offering low-rise sea-facing apartments and boutique hospitality.

name: Dubai Islands
blurb: Five-island coastal destination blending resort beaches, marinas, and architectural low-rise residences.
